name: Telegram Bot API
tagline: HTTPS Bot API for sending messages, media, and bot interactions on Telegram
description: Official HTTP interface for Telegram bots: send and receive messages, media, keyboards, payments, Mini Apps, and updates via long polling or webhooks. Auth is a bot token from @BotFather placed in the request URL. The cloud API is free of charge; messaging is rate-limited, with optional paid higher-throughput broadcasts via Telegram Stars where offered.

auth.details: Bot token issued by @BotFather (self-serve in Telegram). Pass it in the URL path: https://api.telegram.org/bot<token>/METHOD_NAME. No Authorization header required for standard Bot API calls.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free unlimited API use (no call quotas or monthly fees). Free messaging subject to rate limits: ~1 msg/sec per private chat, 20 msg/min per group. Bulk free broadcast throughput and paid Stars broadcast rates are separate (see rate_limits).
pricing.paid_plans: Optional paid broadcasts (BotFather): up to 1000 msg/sec; 0.1 Telegram Stars per message over free 30/sec. Requires ≥100,000 Stars balance and ≥100,000 monthly active users.

rate_limits: FAQ: ~1 message/sec per private chat; ≤20 messages/min per group; 429 on excess. Free bulk broadcast about 30 msg/sec; paid broadcasts (BotFather/Stars) can go higher when eligible. Other method limits not fully published.
use_cases: send a text message to a Telegram user or chat
poll getUpdates for new bot messages (long polling)
set or remove a webhook for bot updates
download a file users sent to the bot
send a photo, document, or location to a chat
verify bot token and identity with getMe
